name: fix-fury-serpent
about: Issue #34, Pelor's Fury could not be used on the snake boss: on the Serpents of Demise's own floor (dark_citadel 18, levels/boss_bone_serpent.lvl, the level's BossStart script) a god-mode Paladin of Generosity probes the pick (`hwp gen pick dx dy`, no cast) aimed at every serpent head and at body segments for 30 s: a body segment (BossWormSegment, untargetable, no-buffs) stands for its serpent, so a body aim picks the head (held when it is surfaced, its own reason when it is underground) and a segment over a surfaced head no longer takes the pick. Then a real cast through the skill aimed at the body holds the head (the log names the segment it went through when the pick did), the 60 s boss cooldown and the Blessing spent. Shot fury-serpent.
